sortable.instructions: To pick up an item, press Space or Enter. Use the arrow keys to move it, then press Space or Enter to drop it, or Escape to cancel.
sortable.treeInstructions: To pick up an item, press Space or Enter. Use the up and down arrow keys to move it, then press Space or Enter to drop it, or Escape to cancel. To change its level, use Indent and Outdent in its actions menu.
sortable.cancelled: Reordering cancelled. {{label}} is back at position {{position}} of {{count}}.
sortable.movedRoot: {{label}} is now at the top level, position {{position}} of {{count}}.
